title: Schools and Post-secondary Educational Institutions with Lactation Rooms
what_it_is: Schools and Post-secondary Educational Institutions with Lactation Rooms

sections.label: Lactation rooms in schools
sections.summary: About 85% of primary, 65% of secondary schools and 90% of junior colleges have lactation rooms, with remaining schools to be provided facilities over three years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Today, about 85% of Primary schools, 65% of Secondary schools and 90% of Junior Colleges/Centralised Institutes have a lactation room.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: For the remaining schools, MOE will progressively provide lactation facilities where feasible over the next three years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Presently, all Institutes of Higher Learning, which means the Autonomous Universities, Polytechnics and Institute of Technical Education (ITE) are equipped with lactation facilities.

sections.label: Lactation room building specifications
sections.summary: Since 2010 lactation rooms were added to building specifications for primary schools, then secondary schools and junior colleges, with facilities and fridges provided.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Since 2010, the requirement for a lactation room was added to the building specification for Primary schools as part of the PERI upgrading.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Subsequently, the same building specification for Secondary schools and also Junior Colleges were similarly updated with the same requirement.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: These are lactation rooms, not meant to be multi-purpose for other reasons.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Schools that were built or upgraded before 2010 will also be provided with a lactation room as part of their on-going or scheduled PERI upgrading for Primary schools; likewise, for the Secondary schools and the Junior Colleges, when the institutions next undergo rebuilding or major upgrading.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: For the lactation rooms, we will provide the necessary facilities and also the fridges; if not in the lactation room, then maybe in the Staff Lounge.

sections.label: Target for school lactation facilities
sections.summary: The target is for every school to have lactation facilities within the next three years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: The target for us, really, is for every school to have lactation facilities within the next three years.
